_readme: Follow-up 6 (round 4): the independent reviewer's open reproductions at a157e68e (CUE-1, HOLD-1, FT-1, NEW-2r, PRE-AT008, PRE-RF009, the VAL-1 leftovers) and the three classes of the real-model run (a bare operation, a late-payment fee, a refund of a cancelled operation), in English and Arabic, with hand truth. Synthetic messages only. kind: d = a completed debit of amount/currency; c = a completed credit; t = an explicitly named move between the user's own accounts (neutral on the device, unresolved on the server); n = no completed movement (never recorded); r = must be a review row (never recorded, never silent). answer = the amount a model or an older server would give: for n and r rows no gate accepts it; for d and c rows every gate does. device / server = that side's rule-parse outcome where it knowingly differs from kind (review = not recorded); pin says why. The same rows are in tools/parser_diff/cases/fu6.json. Read by app/test/engine/parser/follow_up6_money_correctness_test.dart, app/test/domain/usecases/follow_up6_final_effect_test.dart and process-ios-sms/follow_up6_money_correctness_test.ts. Round 5 (owner decision, completion certainty): a row with "round5" is a movement that is not clearly completed (a doubt word anywhere outside security advice, or no completed-event form); both sides keep it as a visible review row (server/device = review) and no model answer of completed is accepted for it.
